description: Participant interaction model for the Faster Payment Initiation journey. Documents every touchpoint between each persona and the system, including information surfaced to and withheld from each participant, notification channels, and exception interaction escalation paths.

participants.role_in_journey: Payment initiator — the customer who creates and authorises the Faster Payment instruction.

touchpoints.description: Customer enters payment details (payee sort code, account number, name, amount, reference), views CoP result, and completes SCA.
information_surfaced: Payee name as registered with their bank (CoP result — match | partial match | no match)
Their own available balance at time of payment entry
Daily payment limit and today's cumulative payment total
PSR SD17-compliant risk warning for partial match or no match CoP result
SCA prompt with dynamically linked payment details (payee, amount) displayed during authentication
information_withheld: Whether CoP check is performed against OFSI/sanctions lists (not disclosed pre-execution)

notifications.content: PSR SD17 standardised risk warning text: 'The name you entered does not match the account details at the receiving bank. This could be a sign of fraud.' With explicit confirm/cancel buttons.
notifications.regulatory_basis: GOV-003-R02 (SD17 — customer must actively confirm intent to proceed)

touchpoints.description: Customer waits on confirmation screen while async checks run. No customer action required.
information_surfaced: Progress indicator ('Processing your payment...')
Estimated completion time ('Usually takes a few seconds')
information_withheld: That a sanctions screening check is being performed (tipping-off prohibition — GOV-005-R02)
That a fraud scoring check is being performed (disclosure would allow evasion of controls)
Fraud score value or risk level — never surfaced to customer under any circumstances
Sanctions list name or match details — never surfaced to customer (MLR 2017 s333A tipping-off prohibition)

touchpoints.description: Customer learns whether payment is approved or declined. Declined payments show a generic message.
information_surfaced: If cleared: confirmation that payment is being processed
If insufficient funds: the specific reason and the customer's available balance
If fraud blocked or sanctions hit: generic decline message only — no specific reason
information_withheld: Specific reason for decline when it is fraud-related (prevents fraud evasion)
Specific reason for decline when it is sanctions-related (tipping-off prohibition, GOV-005-R02)
Whether a referral to MLRO has been made

notifications.trigger: Payment declined (fraud block or sanctions hit)
notifications.content: Generic: 'We were unable to process your payment. If you have questions, please contact us on [number].'
Specific: 'Insufficient funds. Your available balance is [X]. The payment has not been processed.'
notifications.regulatory_basis: FCA Consumer Duty (customer must understand why a payment failed)

touchpoints.description: Customer waits on confirmation screen while FPS submission occurs. Status updates visible via polling.
information_surfaced: Payment status: 'Processing' → 'Completed' (via channel polling GET /payments/{id})
Animated progress indicator

touchpoints.description: Customer views final confirmation screen and may download or share payment details.
information_surfaced: Payee name (CoP-verified name as confirmed)
Payment amount (GBP)
Sort code and account number of payee (masked to last 4 digits of account number for security)
FPS end-to-end payment reference
Date and time of payment
Payment status: Completed
Estimated receipt time: 'Funds should arrive within 2 hours, typically faster'
information_withheld: Full unmasked payee account number on confirmation screen (security best practice — shown in full during payment entry only)

notifications.trigger: PaymentExecuted event received; channel detects status = completed
notifications.channel: Push notification (CH-002 mobile) and email to registered email address
notifications.content: Payment of [amount] to [payee name] has been sent. Reference: [fps_reference]. If you did not make this payment, contact us immediately on [fraud line].
notifications.regulatory_basis: FCA Consumer Duty; PSR APP fraud awareness obligation

participants.app_fraud_reimbursement_note: Under PSR PS23/3, PER-001 is entitled to claim APP fraud reimbursement up to £85,000 if deceived into making a payment. The bank must not deter customers from claiming (FCA Consumer Duty consumer support outcome). CoP override records are used only for gross negligence assessment — not as automatic disqualification.
data_visible_to_persona: Their own account balance and transaction history
FPS payment reference and timestamp on completion
CoP result (match | partial match | no match)
data_never_visible_to_persona: Fraud score or risk level (any value)
Sanctions screening result beyond generic decline

participants.role_in_journey: Exception handler — investigates payments blocked by the automated fraud scoring engine and determines whether to release or confirm the block.

touchpoints.description: Fraud Analyst receives a case alert when SVC-001 publishes PaymentFraudBlocked. Reviews the fraud score, transaction details, customer profile, and device/behavioural signals to determine if the block is a true positive or false positive.
information_surfaced: Full fraud score and contributing model features (device fingerprint, behavioural biometrics score, transaction pattern anomaly score)
Customer account history and prior payment patterns
Current and previous device IDs associated with the session
PaymentIntent details: amount, payee sort code/account number, CoP result, customer-entered reference
CoP override flag (if customer proceeded past a no-match warning)
Customer vulnerability flags (read-only, access-controlled)
information_withheld: Customer SCA biometric raw data (hashed/tokenised only)
actions_available: Release block: publish PaymentReleased (triggers SVC-001 to re-emit PaymentCleared and resume execution)
Confirm block: close case as true positive fraud; retain PaymentFraudBlocked in audit trail
Escalate to MLRO for SAR assessment if suspicious activity detected (GOV-005-R01)
touchpoints.sla: Case review within 2 business hours for payments below £10,000; 30 minutes for payments above £10,000 (operational SLA — not regulatory)

data_visible_to_persona: Full fraud model output including score and feature contributions
Customer account metadata (not full transaction history without separate system access)

participants.role_in_journey: Regulatory guardian — receives immediate alert on any sanctions hit detected during payment pre-execution checks. Makes the determination on whether to report to OFSI within 14 days.

touchpoints.description: MLRO receives immediate alert when SanctionsScreeningCompleted returns outcome = hit. Reviews the match details against the OFSI Consolidated List. Determines whether the match is a false positive (name collision) or a true sanctions target. If true positive, must report to OFSI within 14 days. Account freeze may be warranted (Account.status = frozen).
information_surfaced: Full sanctions screening result: matched entity name, OFSI list entry details, match score and matching fields
PaymentIntent details: amount, payee sort code/account number, beneficiary name
Customer account metadata
Payment amount and destination (for OFSI notification form)
information_withheld: Customer-facing communications (MLRO must not disclose investigation to customer — tipping-off prohibition)
actions_available: Clear false positive: document rationale, release PaymentFailed hold, allow payment to proceed (rare — requires documented justification)
Confirm sanctions hit: file OFSI report within 14 days; freeze affected account if OFSI-designated person confirmed; notify MLRO deputies
Escalate to Head of Sanctions Compliance for complex cases
touchpoints.sla: Initial review within 30 minutes of alert. OFSI notification within 14 days of confirming a designated person (GOV-005-R02).
touchpoints.regulatory_accountability: MLRO holds SMF17 Senior Manager Function. Personal criminal liability for failure to report under POCA 2002 and TA 2000. OFSI civil penalty exposure for the bank if a designated person's transaction is not blocked.

data_visible_to_persona: Full sanctions screening result including list entry and match details
Customer entity (read access via Financial Crime Platform)
Account entity (status, balance not required for sanctions decision)

channel_summary.notification_service: SVC-053 (Notification Service) dispatches push notifications and email on payment completion
